description: The Telangana government is considering an AI-enabled intelligent traffic management system to integrate Hyderabad's traffic signals and reduce congestion. The proposal was discussed with technology firms Analog and MEIL, which showcased solutions for real-time traffic regulation and smart urban infrastructure.

The proposal was discussed with technology firms Analog and MEIL, which showcased solutions for real-time traffic regulation and smart urban infrastructure.
